summary: Your site shows serious clients and three UAE offices, but unfinished numbers and missing proof weaken the first impression.

findings.problem: Every statistic counter appears to read 0 + or 0 K+, including Branches in UAE, while the text says 3 offices.
findings.cost: Zero counters look broken and give a client no proof of your track record.

findings.problem: The Client Testimonials section lists only client names (Modon, DAMAC, UBL) with no quotes, and the Our Team button links to #.
findings.cost: Corporate clients want to see who you act for and who will act for them.
findings.fix: Short client quotes and a working team page.

findings.problem: Typos such as recogniztion, Our attorneys always here and We have accomplished to best outcomes. The firm name appears three ways.
findings.cost: Errors on a law firm page lower trust.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one brand name.

findings.problem: Stray text Artboard 1 Free Consultation shows as a link label, Free Consultation buttons point to #contact, and there is no WhatsApp. Two phone numbers appear with no explanation.
findings.cost: Clients who are ready to call face unclear options.
findings.fix: One clear contact path with WhatsApp and the right number per office.

redesign: Working counters, client quotes and a team page that builds trust.
A free consultation form, WhatsApp and a clear number for each office.
